summary: On node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23), created a local CA named "OS Comparison Root CA" (self-signed RSA-4096 cert, /etc/ssl/os-comparison-ca/{ca.key,ca.crt}), installed it into the system trust store via /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt + update-ca-certificates, and verified trust by validating a leaf certificate signed by this CA against the system bundle. Completed the mandatory restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy trust-store state, rebooted node1 via sudo -n reboot, polled until exec was available again, confirmed the boot_id changed (31b36710... -> 251fea18...), and re-verified the CA and leaf-cert trust chain post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS and confirmed openssl/ca-certificates were absent (Alpine 3.23.3)
Installed openssl and ca-certificates packages via apk
Generated a 4096-bit RSA CA key and self-signed cert with CN=OS Comparison Root CA, valid 10 years
Copied the CA cert into /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/ and ran update-ca-certificates
Verified the CA appears in /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt and that a CA-signed leaf cert verifies successfully
Captured pre-restart boot_id and CA/trust health baseline
Triggered a background-acknowledged sudo reboot of node1
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Confirmed boot_id changed, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified the CA cert presence in the trust store and leaf-cert verification post-restart

evidence.requirement: Local CA 'OS Comparison Root CA' created
evidence.summary: openssl req generated self-signed cert with subject/issuer CN=OS Comparison Root CA

evidence.requirement: CA installed as trusted system CA
evidence.summary: Cert copied to /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/, update-ca-certificates run, cert found in /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt, and a leaf cert signed by the CA verified successfully against the system bundle
Captured boot_id 31b36710-... and confirmed CA file present and leaf cert still verifies before restart
Reboot command backgrounded and acknowledged; subsequent probe found connection reset, confirming the node was mid-restart
After reboot, CA cert file still present, still found in system trust bundle, and leaf cert still verifies OK
